mapper.select:
/* MasterOrderMapper.selectMasterOrderChk : 전자상거래 마스터오더 저장체크 */ SELECT A.*
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COM_OD_CHG_INVOICE WHERE OD_JOB_NO = A.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO AND INVOICE_JOB_NO IS NOT NULL) AS INVOICE_CNT
,CONVERT(DATE, #{obDate}, ${dateFormat}) AS INPUT_OB_DATE
,CONVERT(DATE, #{arDate}, ${dateFormat}) AS INPUT_AR_DATE
,obl.DEST_CODE
FROM( SELECT MAX(ecmOd.MBL_NO) AS MBL_NO ,MAX(ecmOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO) AS MASTER_OD_JOB_NO ,MAX(ecmOd.FINISH_YN) AS FINISH_YN ,MAX(ecmOd.CUST_CODE_LV1) AS CUST_CODE_LV1 ,MAX(CASE ecmOd.BL_TYPE_MH WHEN 'M' THEN ecmOd.ORIG_CODE END) AS ORIG_CODE ,MAX(ecmOd.OB_DATE) AS OB_DATE ,MAX(ecmOd.AR_DATE) AS AR_DATE ,MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(ad.SIMPLE_EDI_STATUS, '') NOT IN ('', 'ERROR') THEN 'Y' END) AS SEND_YN ,COUNT(CASE ecmOd.BL_TYPE_MH WHEN 'H' THEN 1 END) AS HOUSE_CNT FROM TB_ECM_OD ecmOd INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = ecmOd.OD_JOB_NO WHERE ecmOd.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} ) A
INNER JOIN TB_COM_OD cod ON cod.OD_JOB_NO = A.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO INNER JOIN TB_COM_OBL obl ON obl.OBL_JOB_NO = cod.OBL_JOB_NO
/* MasterOrderMapper.selectHouseOrderList : 전자상거래 하우스오더리스트 조회 */ SELECT OD_JOB_NO ,CURRENCY_CODE ,AMOUNT_CUR FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'
/* MasterOrderMapper.selectDeleteHouseList : 전자상거래 하우스오더리스트 조회 */ SELECT OD_JOB_NO ,HBL_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'

/* MasterOrderMapper.selectMasterOrder : 전자상거래 마스터오더조회 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.BOOKING_DATE ,od.BOOKING_NO ,od.REMARKS ,obl.OBL_JOB_NO ,obl.BL_TYPE_SC ,obl.MBL_NO ,obl.HBL_NO ,obl.SR_NO ,obl.CARGO_BL_NO ,obl.SHIPPER_CODE ,obl.SHIPPER_NAME ,obl.SHIPPER_TEL ,obl.SHIPPER_ZIPCODE ,obl.SHIPPER_COUNTRY_CODE ,obl.SHIPPER_STATE_CODE ,obl.SHIPPER_PLACE ,obl.SHIPPER_STREET ,obl.SHIPPER_ATTN ,obl.SHIPPER_FAX ,obl.CONSIGNEE_CODE ,obl.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,obl.CONSIGNEE_TEL ,obl.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,obl.CONSIGNEE_COUNTRY_CODE ,obl.CONSIGNEE_STATE_CODE ,obl.CONSIGNEE_PLACE ,obl.CONSIGNEE_STREET ,obl.CONSIGNEE_ATTN ,obl.CONSIGNEE_FAX ,obl.NOTIFY_CODE ,obl.NOTIFY_NAME ,obl.NOTIFY_TEL ,obl.NOTIFY_ZIPCODE ,obl.NOTIFY_COUNTRY_CODE ,obl.NOTIFY_STATE_CODE ,obl.NOTIFY_PLACE ,obl.NOTIFY_STREET ,obl.NOTIFY_ATTN ,obl.NOTIFY_FAX ,obl.LINE_CODE ,obl.LINE_NAME ,obl.ISSUING_CARRIERS ,obl.IATA_CODE ,obl.ORIG_CODE ,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = obl.ENT_CODE AND (ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE OR ENT_BUSINESS_CODE IS NULL) AND CODE = obl.ORIG_CODE AND ETC1 = obl.BOUND) AS ORIG_COUNTRY ,obl.ORIG_NAME ,obl.VIA_TO_A ,obl.VIA_BY_A ,obl.VIA_TO_B ,obl.VIA_BY_B ,obl.VIA_TO_C ,obl.VIA_BY_C ,obl.DEST_CODE ,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = obl.ENT_CODE AND (ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE OR ENT_BUSINESS_CODE IS NULL) AND CODE = obl.DEST_CODE AND ETC1 = obl.BOUND) AS DEST_COUNTRY ,obl.DEST_NAME ,obl.OB_DATE ,obl.OB_TIME ,obl.AR_DATE ,obl.AR_TIME ,obl.HANDLING_INFO ,obl.HANDLING_SPECIAL ,obl.ACCOUNT_INFO ,obl.INCOTERMS ,obl.CURRENCY_CODE ,obl.DV_CARRIAGE ,obl.DV_CUSTOMS ,obl.DV_INSURANCE ,obl.EDI_COMMODITY_ITEM ,obl.PIECES ,obl.GWT ,obl.RATE_AS_UP_YN ,obl.RATE_CLASS ,obl.RATE_ITEM ,obl.RATE ,obl.FREIGHT_CHARGE ,obl.WEIGHT_CHG_PP ,obl.WEIGHT_CHG_CC ,obl.VALUATION_CHG_PP ,obl.VALUATION_CHG_CC ,obl.TAX_CHG_PP ,obl.TAX_CHG_CC ,obl.DUE_AGENT_PP ,obl.DUE_AGENT_CC ,obl.DUE_CARRIER_PP ,obl.DUE_CARRIER_CC ,obl.PREPAID_CHG_TOTAL ,obl.COLLECT_CHG_TOTAL ,obl.CWT_CBM
,obl.VESSEL_FLIGHT
,CASE WHEN od.BOUND = 'SEA' THEN obl.VESSEL_FLIGHT ELSE ecmOd.LINE_CODE END AS VESSEL_FLIGHT
,obl.VESSEL_VOYAGE ,obl.RECEIPT_CODE ,obl.RECEIPT_NAME ,obl.DISC_CODE ,obl.DISC_NAME ,obl.DELI_CODE ,obl.DELI_NAME ,obl.UNIT_PIECES ,obl.BL_TYPE_LFB ,obl.ORIGINAL_BL_YN ,obl.NO_OF_ORIGINAL ,obl.BL_CARGO_CY_CFS ,obl.BL_SAY ,obl.BL_PAYABLE_AT ,obl.FREIGHT_TERM ,obl.OTHER_TERM ,obl.REGISTER_USER_ID ,obl.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,obl.UPDATE_USER_ID ,obl.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,obl.FWRD_CODE ,obl.FWRD_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(obl.FWRD_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(obl.FWRD_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(obl.FWRD_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(obl.FWRD_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(obl.FWRD_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS FWRD_ADDRESS ,obl.SIGN_HIS_AGENT ,obl.SIGN_ACTING_AS ,obl.ISSUE_DATE ,obl.ISSUE_PLACE_CODE ,obl.SIGN_ATTN ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = od.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME ,(SELECT HANDLING_SPECIAL_NAME FROM TB_COM_OBL_REAL_DELIVERER WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = obl.OBL_JOB_NO) AS HANDLING_SPECIAL_NAME ,CONCAT(ISNULL(obl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(obl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(obl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(obl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(obl.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS SHIPPER_ADDRESS ,CONCAT(ISNULL(obl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(obl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(obl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(obl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(obl.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,CONCAT(ISNULL(obl.NOTIFY_ADDRESS, ''), ISNULL(obl.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_A, ''), ISNULL(obl.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_B, ''), ISNULL(obl.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_C, ''), ISNULL(obl.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_D, '')) AS NOTIFY_ADDRESS ,dbo.Cryptography(obl.OBL_JOB_NO, obl.SHIPPER_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS SHIPPER_BUSINESS_ID ,dbo.Cryptography(obl.OBL_JOB_NO, obl.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID ,dbo.Cryptography(obl.OBL_JOB_NO, obl.NOTIFY_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS NOTIFY_BUSINESS_ID
,ecmOd.VENDER_ID_1 ,ecmOd.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,ecmOd.ORIG_COUNTRY ,ecmOd.DEST_COUNTRY ,ecmOd.CUSTOMS_CODE ,ecmOd.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE ,ecmOd.DEST_PORT ,ecmOd.MRN ,ecmOd.MSN
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_COM_OBL WHERE MBL_JOB_NO = obl.OBL_JOB_NO AND obl.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H') AS HOUSE_CNT ,STUFF((SELECT '|' + MARKS_GOODS FROM TB_COM_OBL_MARK WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = obl.OBL_JOB_NO AND MARK_TYPE_LR = 'L' FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS MARKS_GOODS_LEFT ,STUFF((SELECT '|' + MARKS_GOODS FROM TB_COM_OBL_MARK WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = obl.OBL_JOB_NO AND MARK_TYPE_LR = 'R' FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 1, '') AS MARKS_GOODS_RIGHT ,( SELECT CASE WHEN ISNULL(usr.CUSTOMER_CODE, '') = '' THEN '0' ELSE cus.CUSTOMER_LEVEL END FROM TB_SMS_USER usr LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER cus ON cus.ENT_CODE = usr.ENT_CODE AND cus.CUSTOMER_CODE = usr.CUSTOMER_CODE WHERE usr.ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND usr.USER_ID = od.REGISTER_USER_ID ) AS REGISTER_USER_LEVEL FROM TB_COM_OBL obl INNER JOIN TB_COM_OD od ON od.OBL_JOB_NO = obl.OBL_JOB_NO
LEFT JOIN TB_ECM_OD ecmOd ON ecmOd.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO
WHERE obl.OBL_JOB_NO = #{srchOblJobNo}

/* MasterOrderMapper.selectOtherCharge : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER 조회 */ SELECT SEQ_NO ,CHARGE_CODE ,CHARGE_NAME ,FREIGHT_TERM ,CURRENCY_CODE ,RATE_MULTIPLY ,RATE ,AMOUNT ,CHARGE_TYPE_AC ,CHG_CODE_IATA FROM TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{srchOblJobNo}

/* MasterOrderMapper.selectDimension : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_DIMENSION 조회 */ SELECT SEQ_NO ,DIM_WIDTH ,DIM_LENGTH ,DIM_HEIGHT ,DIM_PIECES ,DIM_VOLUMN FROM TB_COM_OBL_DIMENSION WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{srchOblJobNo}

/* MasterOrderMapper.selectLicense : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CUSTOMS_LICENSE 조회 */ SELECT LICENSE_NO ,PIECES ,GWT ,COMBINE_TYPE_A_Z ,COMBINE_PIECES ,PARTIAL_YN ,PARTIAL_SEQ FROM TB_COM_OBL_CUSTOMS_LICENSE WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{srchOblJobNo}

/* MasterOrderMapper.selectContainer : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CONTAINER 조회 */ SELECT CNTR_NO ,CNTR_SEAL_NO_1 ,CNTR_SEAL_NO_2 ,CNTR_SEAL_NO_3 ,CNTR_CODE ,CNTR_EDI_CODE ,CNTR_SUB_CODE ,CNTR_LOAD_TYPE_EL ,PIECES ,UNIT_PIECES ,GWT ,UNIT_WEIGHT ,CBM ,CNTR_OWN_TYPE ,CNTR_PRINT_INFO FROM TB_COM_OBL_CONTAINER WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{srchOblJobNo}
mapper.delete: /* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMasterObl : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMasterOblRealDeliverer : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_REAL_DELIVERER 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_REAL_DELIVERER WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMasterOrder : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OD 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMasterOrderBus : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OD_BUS WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMasterOrderEcm : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMasterOrderAdditional : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteOtherCharge : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_CHG_OTHER WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteDimension : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_DIMENSION 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_DIMENSION WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteLicense : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CUSTOMS_LICENSE 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_CUSTOMS_LICENSE WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteHts : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_EDI_MF_HTS 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_EDI_MF_HTS WHERE MF_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteContainer : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CONTAINER 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_CONTAINER WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteCntrType : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_CNTR_TYPE 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_CNTR_TYPE WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
/* MasterOrderMapper.deleteMark : 전자상거래 마스터오더 TB_COM_OBL_MARK 삭제 */ DELETE FROM TB_COM_OBL_MARK WHERE OBL_JOB_NO = #{oblJobNo}
mapper.select:
/* MasterOrderMapper.selectEcmOrderList : 전자상거래오더 리스트 */ SELECT od.OD_JOB_NO ,od.ENT_CODE ,od.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE ,od.SOLUTION ,od.BOUND ,od.BOUND_TYPE ,od.VENDER_ID_1 ,od.CUST_CODE_LV1 ,od.BL_TYPE_MH ,od.MBL_NO ,od.LINE_CODE ,od.LINE_NAME ,od.ORIG_CODE ,od.ORIG_NAME ,od.DEST_CODE ,od.DEST_NAME ,od.OB_DATE ,od.OB_TIME ,od.AR_DATE ,od.AR_TIME ,od.VESSEL_SIGN ,od.VOYAGE AS VESSEL_VOYAGE ,od.VESSEL_FLIGHT ,od.PIECES ,od.GWT ,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CITY_PORT' AND CODE = od.ORIG_CODE) AS ORIG_COUNTRY ,(SELECT ETC2 FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = od.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'CITY_PORT' AND CODE = od.DEST_CODE) AS DEST_COUNTRY
,(SELECT COUNT(OD_JOB_NO) FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H') AS HOUSE_CNT ,com.OBL_JOB_NO ,com.OD_JOB_NO AS ORIG_OD_JOB_NO FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_ADDITIONAL ad ON ad.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO LEFT JOIN TB_COM_OD com ON com.MBL_NO = od.MBL_NO AND com.SOLUTION = 'ECM' AND com.BL_TYPE_MH = 'M' WHERE od.OD_JOB_NO IN(#{item})
/* MasterOrderMapper.selectHouseSum : 전자상거래오더 하우스합계 */ SELECT SUM(PIECES) AS PIECES ,SUM(GWT) AS GWT ,SUM(CBM) AS CBM FROM TB_ECM_OD WHERE MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND BL_TYPE_MH = 'H'

/* MasterOrderMapper.selectHouseContainerList : 전자상거래오더 하우스 컨테이너 리스트 */ SELECT cntr.CNTR_NO ,MAX(cntr.CNTR_CODE) AS CNTR_CODE ,MAX(cntr.CNTR_EDI_CODE) AS CNTR_EDI_CODE ,MAX(cntr.CNTR_SEAL_NO_1) AS CNTR_SEAL_NO_1 FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_CONTAINER cntr ON cntr.OD_JOB_NO = od.OD_JOB_NO WHERE od.MASTER_OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo} AND od.BL_TYPE_MH = 'H' GROUP BY cntr.CNTR_NO
